webExactAttribution.conclusion: The complete69-query Web decrease equals the old final69 ordinal suffix, comprising the fourth invocation of seven named RPC actions, GET workspace, GET workspace/switcher and16 unknown-context queries. New358 and old first358 have exactly equal [original context, recorded structure, original scope] histogram. Every44 paired SQL-bearing invocation has zero statement or scope-count difference.

webExactAttribution.triggerCause: UNKNOWN: the JSON does not record React/SWR invalidation/focus/remount initiators or a Web navigation timeline. A UI source change or scheduling/cold readiness cause is not established by this paired run.

nativeExactAttribution.conclusion: Native full-login difference is precisely +1 in the fourth coordinator chat invocation and -3 in context-unknown enrollment-scoped SQL. Of58 paired SQL-bearing invocations,57 have identical structure/scope count profiles; only the fourth chat pair differs.
